description:
Specification: after implementation review approval, invoke coverage-upper for changed code using fresh successful coverage evidence. Add meaningful uncovered-branch tests without weakening assertions; document justified exceptions. Re-run affected issue checks after changes, then final mix precommit with the required 900000 ms execution timeout under docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Obtain final human approval before closing this epic.
Files: relevant tests and documentation only as evidence warrants; production fixes return to their owning child and re-review.
Tests before implementation: plan uncovered authorization, alias-error, ordering and terminal-state branches from current reports, not stale percentages. Preserve property tests over mutation sequences and permission defaults.
Action reuse: no new operation; verify consumers still share existing Action/alias/stream/delivery implementation and no replacement state framework slipped in.
Branches: meaningful uncovered branches from the actual final diff; no implementation-mirroring tests.
Mocking: existing external stubs only; preserve isolated configuration and resources.
Docs: record exact tested commit/source state, fresh coverage result, exceptions, review approval and final validation in this issue; correct service docs if the contract changed.
Acceptance: coverage handoff complete, final checks passed, no unresolved behavioral regression, final human approval recorded. No commit, push, merge, GitHub reply or bw sync is authorized merely by epic creation.

Required policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/testing-approach.md; documentation edits additionally follow docs/documentation.md. No implementation authorized yet.
